scientific_limitations.inferred_index_only: TDI is an inferred degradation severity index, not physical tread depth in mm or rubber loss.
scientific_limitations.not_a_probability: TDI is not a failure probability or guaranteed failure prediction.
scientific_limitations.uncalibrated_weights: Component weights are engineering assumptions (MODEL PARAMETER — DEMO ASSUMPTION).
scientific_limitations.telemetry_limitations: FastF1 does not provide tyre temperature, tyre pressure, wheel speeds, slip angles, or corner-specific loads.
scientific_limitations.qualifying_limitation: Single-lap qualifying telemetry contains no multi-lap tyre-age progression; confidence remains constrained.
scientific_limitations.confounding_overlap: Longitudinal residuals contain aerodynamic model mismatch and non-tyre transient dynamics.
